title: WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones
description:
Available for Steam Deck

Об игре

WendyQuest is 100% fresh and 100% human made!

When mechanized monsters invade a culinary kingdom, it’s up to Wendy to save Savoria from mech-trouble. Welcome to WendyQuest, an epic original adventure where you earn real food as you play.

Play as Wendy and battle Mech Corp’s mechs, solve puzzles, and embark on an epic quest to unite four magical stones to save Savoria. Will you restore order to a realm in peril? The fate of flavor is in your hands.

Dr. Mechborg and his mechs have spread a curse called “Mechtosis” across Savoria using soggy fries, frozen beef & other culinary atrocities. Only Wendy - armed with sacred spatulas, fresh beef, and an ancient prophecy - can restore order to Savoria’s people and end the mechademic once and for all.

Square off against flavorless foes like Golden Archers, Hot Sludge Sundaes and other fast food fiends in strategic turn-based battles. Time your attacks perfectly to deal supersized damage.

Team up with tasty pals including a French Fry Archer, Spicy Chickeneer, Frosty Mage, and more. Each ally brings their own flavor to the table that deals extra damage against specific enemy types.

Journey across five food-themed regions including salty forests, seasoned deserts, rugged beefy bluffs, and Frosty-capped peaks - each filled with hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.
description_short: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.
